en: Multiview chromolithographic greeting postcard titled "Gruss aus Pyrmont," showing scenes from the spa town of Bad Pyrmont: the Fürstliches Schloss beside water and an arched bridge, the Brunnenplatz with the Trinkhalle pavilion full of promenading visitors, Café-Haus Reusch on the Hauptallee under large trees, and the Bahnhof (railway station). Floral decoration and a handwritten German message appear on the front; the reverse is a Deutsche Reichspost card with 5 Pfennig stamp and Hameln postmark.
